results.title: Glitch
results.overview: An isolated girl goes on an adventure when the girl next door falls victim to an alien takeover.

results.title: Shakersss.mov
results.overview: In this self-documented piece, Solange offers a diaristic, devotional, inward gaze, presenting the film as a moving liturgy of praise expressed through reverence for self, God, and the exalted mother Yemaya, emphasizing our profound connection to water and its vital role in existence.

results.title: Me, My Dad, And The Thing In The Shed
results.original_title: Me, My Dad, And The Thing In The Shed
results.overview: An estranged son attempts to reconnect with his aging father while competing for his affection with an otherworldly guest.

results.title: Dead on Distribution
results.overview: A B-movie filmmaker attempts to get a distribution deal for his new slasher flick, but the lead actor has some unsavory ideas about how to promote the film after its poor reception.

results.title: Botnia Paradise
results.overview: Come on this journey on the Baltic Sea's cheapest cruise. In this musical comedy passengers running away from everyday life face off with crew desperately trying to keep the boat afloat.

results.title: My House got Burned
results.overview: Two university friends walk through a high and inhospitable hill in the middle of the city as they confront the idea of mortality following the sudden death of a university mate. Between dusk and dawn, the silences become increasingly deafening, and solitude in company slowly consumes them

results.title: Vain
results.overview: While filming a documentary, Monsters and Mysteries host Elizabeth Pierce along with fellow streamer, Andrew McCoy and filmmaker, Russell Harper, stumble upon footage of a missing girl and uncover the truth behind her disappearance.

results.title: We're All Unwanted Somewhere
results.overview: After getting a scary text, @Pervers3cowgirls go to a clinic to get checked out, where mayhem ensues.

results.title: The Interview
results.overview: Desperate to prove himself a reformed citizen, Tyson Babineaux's history of violence plagues any chances of landing a normal job. Pressured by the threat of losing his family, Tyson unwittingly takes an unconventional interview at a private security firm. There, he's enticed by an offer that can give him a fresh start. But there's a caveat - he has to kill the other candidates to win the job.

results.title: The Sessions
results.overview: A young student undergoing trauma therapy recounts how she was raped by someone she trusted. The camera focuses on the therapist’s face, and we never see the anonymous speaker. The Sessions unfolds almost entirely in this space, where the young woman speaks openly about the impact of the rape. Outside the therapy room she doesn’t dare speak to anyone else about it—only her boyfriend knows what happened.

results.title: After Divorce
results.overview: A divorced veteran, obsessed with Hamlet, battles his inner demons as he hears a voice from the fairy world.

results.title: Old House
results.overview: When the past haunts the present and frightens the future, there's only one option: confront it. Two sisters travel to their abandoned family home in the Russian hinterland to uncover the mystery surrounding the tragedy that shaped their lives.

results.title: Vanilla
results.overview: When Bastien has an affair with a woman, Matt finds it increasingly difficult to forget. And when they meet Florent, things take an unexpected turn.

results.title: The Ghost of Lady Marbella
results.overview: "The Ghost of Lady Marbella" is a Latino-British story about Don Fico's journey to find Lady Marbella, with the help of a mysterious medium who offers him the opportunity to return to the Buenos Aires of his dreams.

results.title: The Incubator
results.overview: A hesitant wife and her blabbermouth husband try to keep their new pregnancy news a secret when attending their nosey family Christmas party.

results.title: I Am Pleased
results.overview: A teenage girl dreams of studying abroad, but her father's rejection threatens to derail her plans, forcing her to confront her family's troubled past and find strength within herself to pursue her dreams.

results.title: Big Rock Burning
results.overview: A gripping documentary exploring the resilient spirit of Malibu's Big Rock community as they rebuild from the ashes of the devastating Palisades Fire, one of America's worst wildfires.

results.title: To Kill a Mongolian Horse
results.overview: Amid the wintry steppes, Saina, a Mongolian horseman turned cultural performer, tends his ranch during the day and performs horseback tricks for audiences at night. Unlike the majestic cavalryman he portrays in the show, Saina discovers that his herdsman’s life is on the verge of disintegration.

results.title: Anything for Ratings: Decades of Lowbrow
results.original_title: Vale Tudo por Audiência: As Décadas da Baixaria
results.overview: This documentary takes a deep dive into the history of Brazilian broadcast television, focusing on the decades when the pursuit of the number one spot in the ratings pushed every ethical boundary. Through a detailed analysis and interviews with people who experienced it behind the scenes, whether as viewers or industry insiders, the film brings back the era of live variety shows, hidden camera pranks, the rivalry between Gugu and Faustão, and the PCC scandal. More than just a nostalgic look back, the film questions how sensationalism and the exploitation of poverty shaped the behavior of a nation raised in front of the screen, revealing the secrets of a TV industry that wasn’t afraid to get bizarre to hold onto its audience.
